name: ProcessDefinition
label: The input
description: An immutable record preserves the original process model. Current list order, rather than Index, decides a tied priority.

name: ISchedulingStrategy
label: The contract
description: Every algorithm implements one contract and returns the same timeline, job results and metrics.

name: ShortestJobFirstStrategy
label: Choose the shortest
description: LINQ makes the policy explicit: burst length, then arrival, then workload order. Once selected, a job runs to completion.

name: PreemptiveStrategy
label: Share the mechanism
description: SRTF, EDF and LLF supply a priority function to this shared tick-by-tick scheduling loop.

name: RoundRobinStrategy
label: Take turns
description: A FIFO queue controls time slices. New arrivals enter before the running job returns to the queue.

name: ProcessState
label: Measure the result
description: Waiting subtracts execution time from turnaround. Keeping the measures separate makes the tradeoffs visible.
